verses.arabicText: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
verses.englishText: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.englishText: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture[1811] that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
verses.footnotes: [1811] i.e., a combination of the male and female substance, within the womb.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.englishText: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.englishText: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.englishText: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,[1812]

verses.arabicText: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
verses.englishText: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

verses.arabicText: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
verses.englishText: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

verses.arabicText: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.englishText: And they give food in spite of love for it[1813] to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
verses.footnotes: [1813] The meaning here may also be "out of love for Him," i.e., Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

verses.arabicText: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.englishText: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
verses.englishText: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

verses.arabicText: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
verses.englishText: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

verses.arabicText: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
verses.englishText: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

verses.arabicText: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
verses.englishText: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

verses.arabicText: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
verses.englishText: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

verses.arabicText: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.englishText: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

verses.arabicText: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
verses.englishText: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

verses.arabicText: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.englishText: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

verses.arabicText: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
verses.englishText: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
verses.englishText: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
verses.englishText: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

verses.arabicText: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
verses.englishText: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.englishText: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
verses.englishText: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.

verses.arabicText: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
verses.englishText: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.englishText: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

verses.arabicText: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
verses.englishText: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
verses.englishText: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them[1814] a grave Day.
verses.footnotes: [1814] i.e., neglect. The meaning may also be "leave ahead of them."

verses.arabicText: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.englishText: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.englishText: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.englishText: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

verses.arabicText: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
verses.englishText: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
